data.name: Sunny Virwani
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Sunny Virwani has made a big mark in cricket. With 87 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 62*, with an average of 13.87 and a quick strike rate of 99.05. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 31 sixes and 57 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 93.0 overs, taking 52 wickets at an economy rate of 7.18. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
